As we look to the future, we must ensure the U.S. remains competitive by advancing smart, forward-looking AI policies that keep our nation at the forefront of global wireless innovation.

We discussed the Bureau of Industry and Security’s vital role in ensuring the United States stays ahead in the artificial intelligence arms race against the Chinese Communist Party.

As global competition increases in the digital age, technological warfare poses a growing threat to our country. We must ensure our export control system empowers American innovation while protecting national security across physical and digital domains.

It was great to meet with Lantheus, an innovative diagnostics company helping to develop cutting-edge cancer treatments.

We discussed the company’s recent acquisition of Springfield-based Evergreen Theragnostics, their efforts to improve diagnostic accuracy for cancer and other conditions, and how they are leveraging advanced technology and AI to better serve patients nationwide.

Yesterday, I joined the @TheITIInstitute in Phillipsburg to learn about an indoor vertical farm that is leveraging AI technology to grow produce year-round. 

It is great to see New Jersey leading the charge to define a future shaped by AI that can drive American economic growth, create jobs, and further our leadership globally.

As the U.S. forges ahead in the AI race, we must ensure our competitive edge isn't undermined by gaps in our export control system. Importantly, we must prioritize protecting advanced computing chips that power our artificial intelligence.

At the @HouseForeignGOP Subcommittee hearing today, I spoke with experts about closing the loopholes foreign adversaries use to exploit U.S. technology. 

I also highlighted the BIS IT Modernization Act, bipartisan legislation I helped introduce to modernize critical systems at the Bureau of Industry and Security. Through modernization efforts, we can better safeguard American innovation and protect our national security interests.

China is actively working to circumvent U.S. export control laws and illegally obtain American-made AI chips. 

I introduced the Stop Stealing Our Chips Act with @RepJulieJohnson to strengthen enforcement, prevent violations before they occur, and protect our national security. 

Backed by @RepLisaMcClain, @ChinaSelect, @RepMoolenaar, @CongressmanRaja, and @RepJoshHarder, this bill makes it clear that illegal smuggling of U.S. technology will not be tolerated.
Why is a Federal AV framework essential for the U.S. to win the AI race with China?

statements.text:
Artificial intelligence is advancing faster than ever. And today on #NationalAILiteracyDay, we are called to ensure that the next generation is prepared to use AI effectively and responsibly.

I recently introduced the LIFT AI Act, bipartisan legislation that brings AI education into classrooms and gives students the tools they need to succeed in a world driven by innovation.

We must support America's students so they can thrive in a future increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence.

I'm pleased to share that @Google and @OpenAI have endorsed my bill, the LIFT AI Act! 

They join the American Federation of Teachers, the Information Technology Industry Council, and the Software & Information Industry Association in supporting this bipartisan legislation.

The LIFT AI Act would bring AI education into classrooms, equipping students with the skills to thrive in today's rapidly evolving technological landscape.

As artificial intelligence becomes more sophisticated, identifying what’s real and what’s artificially generated has become a real challenge.

That is why, last week, I introduced the Spot the Fakes Act with Congressman Gottheimer and Congressman Liccardo. This legislation would require that AI-generated content carry a built-in label in its metadata so that AI-generated content can be clearly and accurately labeled.

At the @HouseForeignGOP hearing today, I asked Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler about the United States’s export controls and the artificial intelligence arms race with China. 
 
It is critical that the U.S. remains at the forefront of AI development and that our technology is protected by robust export controls. That is why I introduced the Stop Stealing Our Chips Act to create a whistleblower incentive program at the Bureau of Industry and Security. This legislation recently passed the House Foreign Affairs Committee with bipartisan support and passed the Senate with unanimous consent. I look forward to seeing this bill considered on the House Floor.

Today, I questioned LTC Joel Borkert from the Department of State Bureau of Counterterrorism on the changing landscape of technology and the impact of AI on U.S. counterterrorism efforts. 
 
As we remember the murderous act of terror that occurred on September 11th, 2001, we must remain steadfast in our commitment to prevent such evil from ever taking hold again. Congress must work to support the Bureau and their efforts to combat terrorism.

I recently heard from an #NJ07 constituent about her experience with a scam website impersonating her small business. Scams such as these often target seniors and are becoming more prevalent with the development of AI.

Last week, I spoke in support of the Strategic Task Force on Scam Prevention Act, which would create a task force to prevent scams and take action against them, helping individuals and small businesses. 
 
I was pleased to vote in favor of the bill and see it pass through @HouseCommerce.

While AI can be a helpful tool, it is essential that humans remain in control of complex artificial intelligence systems.

The AI Emergency Button Act would ensure that advanced artificial intelligence systems include a technical capability for a human operator to shut down the system. 

I am pleased to introduce the House companion bill to Senator Kennedy's Senate version.

I’ve worked with Haley on several important issues, particularly involving Tech and AI. When I wrote the Fire Grants & Safety Act (now law), my first call was to Bill Pascrell and my second call was to Haley. 

Together, we assembled a huge coalition of Republicans and Democrats to support the bill. We worked tirelessly to get this done and now that law supports thousands of first responders in every corner of the nation.

That’s good government. That’s real bipartisan leadership that gets good things done for the people we represent.

I’m incredibly proud of Haley for putting #CountryOverParty and standing up for what’s right.
